content.short: NFT Drop Finder is a demo of a transfers API workflow to track NFT mints on Polygon.
content.description: NFT Drop Finder demonstrates how to call the Transfers API in a Heroku configuration to create a dashboard that tracks NFT minting and trading activities of persons of interest. The project guides developers through setting up the Heroku environment and deploying their API with keys, enabling them to monitor NFT trades and mints in real time. This template offers a practical example for building an analytics workflow around NFT activity on supported chains.
